q19512.en: The sign shown forbids traffic in both directions.

explain.short: The plain red ring closes the road to all vehicles, whichever way they come from.
explain.rule: 'Divieto di transito' (no vehicles) is a white disc with a red ring. No vehicle of any kind may go in, in either direction; pedestrians may.
explain.trap: 'nei due sensi' means in both directions: the ban works both ways.

sceneParams.caption: No vehicles, in both directions

q19513.en: The sign shown forbids transit to all vehicles.

explain.short: This is the 'no vehicles' sign: every vehicle is banned, with or without a motor.
explain.rule: 'Divieto di transito' (no vehicles) is a white disc with a red ring. No vehicle of any kind may go in, in either direction; pedestrians may.
explain.trap: 'tutti i veicoli' means all vehicles: no exceptions without an extra panel.

sceneParams.caption: All vehicles banned

q19514.en: The sign shown forbids traffic to motor quadricycles.

explain.short: Motor quadricycles (small four-wheel vehicles) are vehicles, so they are banned too.
explain.rule: 'Divieto di transito' (no vehicles) is a white disc with a red ring. No vehicle of any kind may go in, in either direction; pedestrians may.
explain.trap: 'quadricicli a motore' sounds special, but they are vehicles like any other.

sceneParams.caption: Quadricycles are vehicles: banned too

q19515.en: The sign shown is placed at both entrances of the road.

explain.short: The road is closed from both sides, so the sign stands at each way in.
explain.rule: 'Divieto di transito' (no vehicles) is a white disc with a red ring. No vehicle of any kind may go in, in either direction; pedestrians may.
explain.trap: 'entrambi gli accessi' means both entrances: one sign at each end.

sceneParams.caption: One sign at each entrance of the road

q19516.en: The sign shown forbids transit to lorries.

explain.short: Lorries are vehicles, and this sign bans all vehicles.
explain.rule: 'Divieto di transito' (no vehicles) is a white disc with a red ring. No vehicle of any kind may go in, in either direction; pedestrians may.
explain.trap: 'autocarri' means lorries: they are not a special case, they are banned like all vehicles.

sceneParams.caption: Lorries banned too

q19517.en: The sign shown can be valid only for a limited time, shown on an additional panel.

explain.short: A panel under the sign can give hours or days: the ban then applies only at those times.
explain.rule: 'Divieto di transito' (no vehicles) is a white disc with a red ring. No vehicle of any kind may go in, in either direction; pedestrians may.
explain.trap: 'può avere' means 'can have': the time limit is possible, not always there.

sceneParams.caption: A panel can limit it to certain hours

q19518.en: The sign shown allows pedestrians through.

explain.short: The sign bans vehicles only; people on foot are not vehicles, so they may pass.
explain.rule: 'Divieto di transito' (no vehicles) is a white disc with a red ring. No vehicle of any kind may go in, in either direction; pedestrians may.
explain.trap: 'pedoni' means pedestrians: the ban is for vehicles, not for people walking.

sceneParams.caption: Vehicles banned, pedestrians may pass

q19519.en: The sign shown forbids traffic to mopeds.

explain.short: Mopeds are vehicles, so the 'no vehicles' sign bans them too.
explain.rule: 'Divieto di transito' (no vehicles) is a white disc with a red ring. No vehicle of any kind may go in, in either direction; pedestrians may.
explain.trap: 'ciclomotori' means mopeds: small, but still vehicles.

sceneParams.caption: Mopeds banned too

q19520.en: The sign shown is a NO VEHICLES sign.

explain.short: A white disc with a plain red ring is exactly the 'divieto di transito' sign.
explain.rule: 'Divieto di transito' (no vehicles) is a white disc with a red ring. No vehicle of any kind may go in, in either direction; pedestrians may.
explain.trap: 'DIVIETO DI TRANSITO' is the official name: do not confuse it with 'senso vietato' (red disc, white bar).

sceneParams.caption: This is the no-vehicles sign

q19521.en: The sign shown allows bicycles through.

explain.short: Bicycles are vehicles, so they are banned too; only pedestrians may pass.
explain.rule: 'Divieto di transito' (no vehicles) is a white disc with a red ring. No vehicle of any kind may go in, in either direction; pedestrians may.
explain.trap: 'biciclette' are vehicles: they do not escape this ban.

sceneParams.caption: Wrong: bicycles are banned too

q19522.en: The sign shown forbids transit only to motor vehicles.

explain.short: The ban is for ALL vehicles, also those without a motor, like bicycles and carts.
explain.rule: 'Divieto di transito' (no vehicles) is a white disc with a red ring. No vehicle of any kind may go in, in either direction; pedestrians may.
explain.trap: 'unicamente' means only: the ban is wider, it covers every vehicle.

sceneParams.caption: Wrong: all vehicles, not only motor ones

q19523.en: The sign shown, as a rule, allows you to drive into the road to park and to load and unload.

explain.short: No vehicle may go in, not even to park or to load goods, unless a panel says so.
explain.rule: 'Divieto di transito' (no vehicles) is a white disc with a red ring. No vehicle of any kind may go in, in either direction; pedestrians may.
explain.trap: 'di norma' means as a rule: as a rule you may NOT enter at all.

sceneParams.caption: Wrong: no entry, not even to park or load

q19524.en: The sign shown does not allow you to enter, but only to leave the road.

explain.short: The ban works in both directions; 'enter only from the other side' is the 'senso vietato' sign.
explain.rule: 'Divieto di transito' (no vehicles) is a white disc with a red ring. No vehicle of any kind may go in, in either direction; pedestrians may.
explain.trap: 'ma solo l'uscita' (but only the exit) describes a one-way street, not this sign.

sceneParams.caption: Wrong: banned both ways, this is not one-way

q19525.en: The sign shown means that traffic is one-way.

explain.short: It does not show a one-way road: it closes the road to vehicles in both directions.
explain.rule: 'Divieto di transito' (no vehicles) is a white disc with a red ring. No vehicle of any kind may go in, in either direction; pedestrians may.
explain.trap: 'senso unico' (one-way) is a different sign; this one is 'divieto di transito'.

sceneParams.caption: Wrong: it closes the road, it is not one-way

q19526.en: The sign shown allows cars with an electric motor through.

explain.short: Electric cars are vehicles like the others, so they are banned too.
explain.rule: 'Divieto di transito' (no vehicles) is a white disc with a red ring. No vehicle of any kind may go in, in either direction; pedestrians may.
explain.trap: 'motore elettrico' (electric motor) gives no exception.

sceneParams.caption: Wrong: electric cars are banned too

q19527.en: The sign shown is a danger sign.

explain.short: A round sign with a red ring is a prohibition sign; danger signs are triangles.
explain.rule: 'Divieto di transito' (no vehicles) is a white disc with a red ring. No vehicle of any kind may go in, in either direction; pedestrians may.
explain.trap: 'pericolo' (danger) signs are red-edged triangles, not circles.

sceneParams.caption: Wrong: round red ring = prohibition

q19528.en: The sign shown, if crossed out in red, marks the end of the ban.

explain.short: End-of-ban signs are crossed by black or grey diagonal stripes, not by a red bar.
explain.rule: 'Divieto di transito' (no vehicles) is a white disc with a red ring. No vehicle of any kind may go in, in either direction; pedestrians may.
explain.trap: 'barrato in rosso' (crossed in red) is wrong: the end bar is not red.

sceneParams.caption: Wrong: end of ban is not shown in red

q19529.en: The sign shown forbids you to enter a road that can instead be entered from the other end.

explain.short: It closes a one-way street from this side only; vehicles enter from the opposite end.
explain.rule: 'Senso vietato' (no entry) is a red disc with a white bar. It stands at the exit end of a one-way street: no vehicle may enter from this side.
explain.trap: 'accessibile invece dall'altra parte' is the key: the road is open from the other end.

sceneParams.caption: No entry here; enter from the other end

q19530.en: Vehicles without a motor must obey the ban given by the sign shown.

explain.short: The ban is for all vehicles: bicycles and carts must also not enter.
explain.rule: 'Senso vietato' (no entry) is a red disc with a white bar. It stands at the exit end of a one-way street: no vehicle may enter from this side.
explain.trap: 'senza motore' (without a motor) gives no exception.

sceneParams.caption: Bicycles and carts must obey too

q19531.en: Taxis must obey the ban given by the sign shown.

explain.short: Taxis are vehicles like the others: they may not enter the wrong way.
explain.rule: 'Senso vietato' (no entry) is a red disc with a white bar. It stands at the exit end of a one-way street: no vehicle may enter from this side.
explain.trap: 'taxi' do not have a special exception here.

sceneParams.caption: Taxis must obey too

q19532.en: Motor quadricycles must obey the ban given by the sign shown.

explain.short: Quadricycles are vehicles, so they must obey the no-entry ban.
explain.rule: 'Senso vietato' (no entry) is a red disc with a white bar. It stands at the exit end of a one-way street: no vehicle may enter from this side.
explain.trap: 'quadricicli a motore' sounds special, but they are vehicles like any other.

sceneParams.caption: Quadricycles must obey too

q19533.en: The ban given by the sign shown must be obeyed at night too.

explain.short: With no time panel, the ban is valid all day and all night.
explain.rule: 'Senso vietato' (no entry) is a red disc with a white bar. It stands at the exit end of a one-way street: no vehicle may enter from this side.
explain.trap: 'anche nelle ore notturne' (at night too): the ban never switches off.

sceneParams.caption: Valid day and night

q19534.en: The sign shown is placed on a one-way road.

explain.short: It stands at the exit end of a one-way street, to stop vehicles entering the wrong way.
explain.rule: 'Senso vietato' (no entry) is a red disc with a white bar. It stands at the exit end of a one-way street: no vehicle may enter from this side.
explain.trap: 'senso unico' (one-way): this sign always goes with a one-way road.

sceneParams.caption: Placed at the exit of a one-way road

q19535.en: The sign shown is a NO ENTRY sign.

explain.short: A red disc with a white horizontal bar is exactly the 'senso vietato' sign.
explain.rule: 'Senso vietato' (no entry) is a red disc with a white bar. It stands at the exit end of a one-way street: no vehicle may enter from this side.
explain.trap: 'SENSO VIETATO' (no entry) is not 'divieto di transito' (white disc, red ring).

sceneParams.caption: This is the no-entry sign

q19536.en: The sign shown allows motorcycles to enter.

explain.short: Motorcycles are vehicles: they may not enter the wrong way either.
explain.rule: 'Senso vietato' (no entry) is a red disc with a white bar. It stands at the exit end of a one-way street: no vehicle may enter from this side.
explain.trap: 'consente' (allows) is wrong: there is no exception for 'motocicli'.

sceneParams.caption: Wrong: motorcycles may not enter

q19537.en: The sign shown allows mopeds to enter.

explain.short: Mopeds are vehicles: they may not enter the wrong way either.
explain.rule: 'Senso vietato' (no entry) is a red disc with a white bar. It stands at the exit end of a one-way street: no vehicle may enter from this side.
explain.trap: 'consente' (allows) is wrong: there is no exception for 'ciclomotori'.

sceneParams.caption: Wrong: mopeds may not enter

q19538.en: The sign shown does not allow vehicles to drive on that road.

explain.short: Vehicles do drive on that road, but only in the other direction; you just may not enter from here.
explain.rule: 'Senso vietato' (no entry) is a red disc with a white bar. It stands at the exit end of a one-way street: no vehicle may enter from this side.
explain.trap: 'non consente la circolazione' is too strong: traffic flows, but one-way.

sceneParams.caption: Wrong: traffic flows, only the other way

q19539.en: The sign shown is placed on a two-way carriageway.

explain.short: It is used on one-way roads, at the end where you may not enter.
explain.rule: 'Senso vietato' (no entry) is a red disc with a white bar. It stands at the exit end of a one-way street: no vehicle may enter from this side.
explain.trap: 'doppio senso' (two-way) is wrong: this sign means one-way.

sceneParams.caption: Wrong: it is used on one-way roads

q19540.en: The sign shown forbids parking, but not stopping.

explain.short: It forbids driving in, not parking: 'no parking' is a blue disc with a red ring and one red bar.
explain.rule: 'Senso vietato' (no entry) is a red disc with a white bar. It stands at the exit end of a one-way street: no vehicle may enter from this side.
explain.trap: 'vieta la sosta' (forbids parking) belongs to a different sign.

sceneParams.caption: Wrong: it forbids entering, not parking

explain.short: It forbids entering the road; 'no overtaking' shows two cars in a red ring.
explain.rule: 'Senso vietato' (no entry) is a red disc with a white bar. It stands at the exit end of a one-way street: no vehicle may enter from this side.
explain.trap: 'sorpasso' (overtaking) is a different sign, with two cars.

sceneParams.caption: Wrong: it forbids entering, not overtaking

q19542.en: The sign shown allows local traffic in both directions.

explain.short: No one may enter the wrong way, local residents included, unless a panel says so.
explain.rule: 'Senso vietato' (no entry) is a red disc with a white bar. It stands at the exit end of a one-way street: no vehicle may enter from this side.
explain.trap: 'traffico locale' (local traffic) gets no exception in 'entrambi i sensi' (both directions).

sceneParams.caption: Wrong: no one enters, not even locals

q19543.en: In towns, the ban given by the sign shown must be obeyed from 8:00 to 20:00.

explain.short: The ban is valid all day and night; there is no fixed time window in towns.
explain.rule: 'Senso vietato' (no entry) is a red disc with a white bar. It stands at the exit end of a one-way street: no vehicle may enter from this side.
explain.trap: 'dalle ore 8.00 alle ore 20.00' invents a time limit that does not exist.

sceneParams.caption: Wrong: valid 24 hours, not 8 to 20

q19544.en: The sign shown is a NO VEHICLES sign.

explain.short: This red disc with a white bar is 'senso vietato'; 'divieto di transito' is a white disc with a red ring.
explain.rule: 'Senso vietato' (no entry) is a red disc with a white bar. It stands at the exit end of a one-way street: no vehicle may enter from this side.
explain.trap: 'DIVIETO DI TRANSITO' is the wrong name for this sign.

sceneParams.caption: Wrong: this is no entry, not no vehicles

q19545.en: The sign shown allows a car to overtake a motorcycle.

explain.short: The ban is about overtaking motor vehicles other than motorcycles and mopeds, so passing a motorcycle is allowed.
explain.rule: 'Divieto di sorpasso' (no overtaking): you may not overtake motor vehicles, except two-wheeled motorcycles and mopeds. Bicycles and vehicles without a motor may be overtaken.
explain.trap: 'motociclo' (motorcycle) is one of the exceptions you may still overtake.

sceneParams.caption: A car may overtake a motorcycle

q19546.en: The sign shown can be found both on urban and on extra-urban roads.

explain.short: No overtaking can be needed on any kind of road, in towns or outside.
explain.rule: 'Divieto di sorpasso' (no overtaking): you may not overtake motor vehicles, except two-wheeled motorcycles and mopeds. Bicycles and vehicles without a motor may be overtaken.
explain.trap: 'sia ... che' means both: the sign is not limited to one type of road.

sceneParams.caption: Used in towns and outside

q19547.en: Sign (A) can be repeated after each junction with additional panel (B).

explain.short: After a junction the ban is reminded with the same sign and a panel with arrows up and down, meaning it continues.
explain.rule: 'Divieto di sorpasso' (no overtaking): you may not overtake motor vehicles, except two-wheeled motorcycles and mopeds. Bicycles and vehicles without a motor may be overtaken.
explain.trap: 'può essere ripetuto' (can be repeated): repeating is allowed, with panel B.

sceneParams.caption: Repeated after junctions with panel B

q19548.en: The sign shown forbids overtaking lorries.

explain.short: Lorries are motor vehicles (not motorcycles or mopeds), so you may not overtake them.
explain.rule: 'Divieto di sorpasso' (no overtaking): you may not overtake motor vehicles, except two-wheeled motorcycles and mopeds. Bicycles and vehicles without a motor may be overtaken.
explain.trap: 'autocarri' (lorries) are motor vehicles: overtaking them is banned.

sceneParams.caption: No overtaking lorries

q19549.en: The sign shown allows you to overtake mopeds.

explain.short: Mopeds are one of the exceptions: you may still overtake them.
explain.rule: 'Divieto di sorpasso' (no overtaking): you may not overtake motor vehicles, except two-wheeled motorcycles and mopeds. Bicycles and vehicles without a motor may be overtaken.
explain.trap: 'ciclomotori' (mopeds) may be overtaken even with this sign.

sceneParams.caption: Mopeds may be overtaken

q19550.en: The sign shown forbids overtaking between motor vehicles, even if the manoeuvre can be done within your half of the road.

explain.short: The ban holds even when there is room on your own side: you may not overtake motor vehicles at all.
explain.rule: 'Divieto di sorpasso' (no overtaking): you may not overtake motor vehicles, except two-wheeled motorcycles and mopeds. Bicycles and vehicles without a motor may be overtaken.
explain.trap: 'anche se' (even if) is the key: having space is no excuse.

sceneParams.caption: Banned even if there is room

q19551.en: The sign shown allows a motorcycle to overtake a car.

explain.short: The ban applies to every driver, motorcyclists too: no one may overtake a car here.
explain.rule: 'Divieto di sorpasso' (no overtaking): you may not overtake motor vehicles, except two-wheeled motorcycles and mopeds. Bicycles and vehicles without a motor may be overtaken.
explain.trap: 'motociclo' may BE overtaken, but it may not overtake a car.

sceneParams.caption: Wrong: a motorcycle may not pass a car

q19552.en: The sign shown means the right lane is reserved for slow vehicles.

explain.short: It forbids overtaking; a lane for slow vehicles has a different sign.
explain.rule: 'Divieto di sorpasso' (no overtaking): you may not overtake motor vehicles, except two-wheeled motorcycles and mopeds. Bicycles and vehicles without a motor may be overtaken.

sceneParams.caption: Wrong: it forbids overtaking

q19553.en: The sign shown allows you to overtake a car as long as you do not cross the solid line.

explain.rule: 'Divieto di sorpasso' (no overtaking): you may not overtake motor vehicles, except two-wheeled motorcycles and mopeds. Bicycles and vehicles without a motor may be overtaken.

sceneParams.caption: Wrong: no overtaking cars at all

q19554.en: The sign shown forbids a motorcycle to overtake a bicycle.

sceneParams.caption: Wrong: bicycles may be overtaken

q19555.en: The sign shown allows overtaking between cars if there is no solid white line.

sceneParams.caption: Wrong: banned with or without a line

sceneParams.caption: A lorry may overtake a motorcycle

q19557.en: Where the sign shown is present, a car may overtake a moped.

explain.trap: 'ciclomotore' (moped) may be overtaken even with this sign.

sceneParams.caption: A car may overtake a moped

q19558.en: The sign shown allows road trains, articulated lorries and articulated buses through.

q19570.en: The sign shown allows overtaking bicycles.

explain.short: Bicycles have no motor, so you may overtake them.
explain.rule: 'Divieto di sorpasso' (no overtaking): you may not overtake motor vehicles, except two-wheeled motorcycles and mopeds. Bicycles and vehicles without a motor may be overtaken.
explain.trap: 'biciclette' (bicycles) are not motor vehicles: overtaking is allowed.

sceneParams.caption: Bicycles may be overtaken

q19571.en: Where the sign shown is present, overtaking vehicles without a motor is allowed.

explain.short: The ban is only about motor vehicles; vehicles without a motor may be overtaken.
explain.rule: 'Divieto di sorpasso' (no overtaking): you may not overtake motor vehicles, except two-wheeled motorcycles and mopeds. Bicycles and vehicles without a motor may be overtaken.
explain.trap: 'sprovvisti di motore' (without a motor) is the key: they are outside the ban.

sceneParams.caption: Non-motor vehicles may be overtaken

q19572.en: Where the sign shown is present, overtaking hand-pushed vehicles is allowed.

explain.short: Hand carts have no motor, so you may overtake them.
explain.rule: 'Divieto di sorpasso' (no overtaking): you may not overtake motor vehicles, except two-wheeled motorcycles and mopeds. Bicycles and vehicles without a motor may be overtaken.
explain.trap: 'veicoli a braccia' (hand-pushed vehicles) have no motor.

sceneParams.caption: Hand carts may be overtaken

q19573.en: Where the sign shown is present, overtaking horse-drawn carriages is allowed.

explain.short: Horse carriages have no motor, so you may overtake them.
explain.rule: 'Divieto di sorpasso' (no overtaking): you may not overtake motor vehicles, except two-wheeled motorcycles and mopeds. Bicycles and vehicles without a motor may be overtaken.
explain.trap: 'carrozze a cavalli' (horse carriages) have no motor.

sceneParams.caption: Horse carriages may be overtaken

q19574.en: Where the sign shown is present, overtaking motor vehicles with an electric motor is allowed.

explain.short: An electric motor is still a motor: these vehicles may not be overtaken.
explain.rule: 'Divieto di sorpasso' (no overtaking): you may not overtake motor vehicles, except two-wheeled motorcycles and mopeds. Bicycles and vehicles without a motor may be overtaken.
explain.trap: 'motore elettrico' (electric motor) gives no exception.

sceneParams.caption: Wrong: electric vehicles may not be overtaken

q19575.en: The sign shown warns of a narrowing ahead.

explain.short: It is a prohibition (no overtaking); a narrowing is a danger sign, a triangle.
explain.rule: 'Divieto di sorpasso' (no overtaking): you may not overtake motor vehicles, except two-wheeled motorcycles and mopeds. Bicycles and vehicles without a motor may be overtaken.
explain.trap: 'preannuncia una strettoia' (warns of a narrowing) describes a danger sign.

sceneParams.caption: Wrong: it forbids overtaking

q19576.en: Where the sign shown is present, overtaking agricultural machines is allowed.

explain.short: Agricultural machines (tractors) have a motor and are not motorcycles, so they may not be overtaken.
explain.rule: 'Divieto di sorpasso' (no overtaking): you may not overtake motor vehicles, except two-wheeled motorcycles and mopeds. Bicycles and vehicles without a motor may be overtaken.
explain.trap: 'macchine agricole' have a motor: no exception for them.

sceneParams.caption: Wrong: tractors may not be overtaken

q19577.en: Where the sign shown is present, overtaking operating machines is allowed.

explain.short: Operating machines (works vehicles) have a motor, so they may not be overtaken.
explain.rule: 'Divieto di sorpasso' (no overtaking): you may not overtake motor vehicles, except two-wheeled motorcycles and mopeds. Bicycles and vehicles without a motor may be overtaken.
explain.trap: 'macchine operatrici' (operating machines) have a motor: no exception.

sceneParams.caption: Wrong: works machines may not be overtaken

q19578.en: Where the sign shown is present, overtaking motor vehicles that are going very slowly is allowed.

explain.short: Speed does not matter: a slow motor vehicle may not be overtaken either.
explain.rule: 'Divieto di sorpasso' (no overtaking): you may not overtake motor vehicles, except two-wheeled motorcycles and mopeds. Bicycles and vehicles without a motor may be overtaken.
explain.trap: 'molto lentamente' (very slowly) gives no exception.

sceneParams.caption: Wrong: slow motor vehicles too

q19579.en: Where the sign shown is present, overtaking vehicles that have signalled they will turn right is allowed.

explain.short: A right indicator gives no exception: if it is a motor vehicle, you may not overtake it.
explain.rule: 'Divieto di sorpasso' (no overtaking): you may not overtake motor vehicles, except two-wheeled motorcycles and mopeds. Bicycles and vehicles without a motor may be overtaken.
explain.trap: 'svoltare a destra' (turn right) does not lift the ban.

sceneParams.caption: Wrong: the ban still applies

q19580.en: Where the sign shown is present, you must keep a distance of at least 70 metres from the vehicle in front.

explain.short: The sign sets a minimum gap of 70 m from the vehicle ahead.
explain.rule: 'Distanziamento minimo obbligatorio' (compulsory minimum distance): every vehicle must stay at least the distance shown, here 70 m, behind the vehicle in front.
explain.trap: 'almeno' (at least) is right: 70 m or more.

sceneParams.caption: At least 70 m from the vehicle ahead
lines: Stay at least 70 m behind the vehicle ahead
Applies to every vehicle, at any speed

q19581.en: Where the sign shown is present, a vehicle may drive 80 metres behind the one in front.

explain.short: 80 m is more than the minimum of 70 m, so it is allowed.
explain.rule: 'Distanziamento minimo obbligatorio' (compulsory minimum distance): every vehicle must stay at least the distance shown, here 70 m, behind the vehicle in front.
explain.trap: '80 metri' is more than 70: the sign sets a minimum, not a maximum.

sceneParams.caption: 80 m is fine: more than 70 m
lines: Stay at least 70 m behind the vehicle ahead
Applies to every vehicle, at any speed

q19582.en: The sign shown forbids a vehicle to drive less than 70 metres behind the one in front.

explain.short: Closer than 70 m is not allowed: that is the minimum distance.
explain.rule: 'Distanziamento minimo obbligatorio' (compulsory minimum distance): every vehicle must stay at least the distance shown, here 70 m, behind the vehicle in front.
explain.trap: 'a meno di 70 metri' (less than 70 m) is exactly what is forbidden.

sceneParams.caption: Closer than 70 m is forbidden
lines: Stay at least 70 m behind the vehicle ahead
Applies to every vehicle, at any speed

q19583.en: The sign shown also applies to motorcycles.

explain.short: The minimum distance applies to every vehicle, motorcycles included.
explain.rule: 'Distanziamento minimo obbligatorio' (compulsory minimum distance): every vehicle must stay at least the distance shown, here 70 m, behind the vehicle in front.
explain.trap: 'anche' (also): motorcycles have no exception.

sceneParams.caption: Motorcycles too
lines: Stay at least 70 m behind the vehicle ahead
Applies to every vehicle, at any speed

q19584.en: The sign shown must be obeyed even when driving at low speed.

explain.short: The 70 m minimum holds at any speed, slow or fast.
explain.rule: 'Distanziamento minimo obbligatorio' (compulsory minimum distance): every vehicle must stay at least the distance shown, here 70 m, behind the vehicle in front.
explain.trap: 'anche quando' (even when): low speed gives no exception.

sceneParams.caption: Valid at any speed
lines: Stay at least 70 m behind the vehicle ahead
Applies to every vehicle, at any speed

q19585.en: The sign shown requires you to keep the minimum distance shown.

explain.short: That is the meaning of the sign: keep at least the distance written on it.
explain.rule: 'Distanziamento minimo obbligatorio' (compulsory minimum distance): every vehicle must stay at least the distance shown, here 70 m, behind the vehicle in front.
explain.trap: 'distanza minima' (minimum distance) is right: at least, not at most.

sceneParams.caption: Keep at least the distance shown
lines: Stay at least 70 m behind the vehicle ahead
Applies to every vehicle, at any speed

q19586.en: The sign shown requires vehicles to drive less than 70 metres apart.

explain.short: It is the opposite: vehicles must stay MORE than 70 m apart.
explain.rule: 'Distanziamento minimo obbligatorio' (compulsory minimum distance): every vehicle must stay at least the distance shown, here 70 m, behind the vehicle in front.
explain.trap: 'a meno di' (less than) turns the rule upside down.

sceneParams.caption: Wrong: at least 70 m, not less
lines: Stay at least 70 m behind the vehicle ahead
Applies to every vehicle, at any speed

q19587.en: The sign shown requires the vehicle in front to keep the one behind at least 70 metres away.

explain.short: The duty is on the vehicle BEHIND: it must keep 70 m from the one in front.
explain.rule: 'Distanziamento minimo obbligatorio' (compulsory minimum distance): every vehicle must stay at least the distance shown, here 70 m, behind the vehicle in front.
explain.trap: 'il veicolo che precede' (the vehicle in front) is the wrong one: it is the follower's job.

sceneParams.caption: Wrong: the follower keeps the distance
lines: Stay at least 70 m behind the vehicle ahead
Applies to every vehicle, at any speed

q19588.en: The sign shown gives the maximum distance to keep, only on stretches where overtaking is forbidden.

explain.short: It is a MINIMUM distance, valid wherever the sign is, not only where overtaking is banned.
explain.rule: 'Distanziamento minimo obbligatorio' (compulsory minimum distance): every vehicle must stay at least the distance shown, here 70 m, behind the vehicle in front.
explain.trap: 'massima' (maximum) and 'esclusivamente' (only) are both wrong.

sceneParams.caption: Wrong: a minimum, valid wherever posted
lines: Stay at least 70 m behind the vehicle ahead
Applies to every vehicle, at any speed

q19589.en: The sign shown warns that a ban on cars begins in 70 metres.

explain.short: The 70 m is the gap between vehicles, not the distance to a ban.
explain.rule: 'Distanziamento minimo obbligatorio' (compulsory minimum distance): every vehicle must stay at least the distance shown, here 70 m, behind the vehicle in front.
explain.trap: 'preavvisa' (warns in advance) is wrong: it is a prescription about following distance.

sceneParams.caption: Wrong: 70 m is the gap between vehicles
lines: Stay at least 70 m behind the vehicle ahead
Applies to every vehicle, at any speed

q19590.en: Where the sign shown is present, cars may not go faster than 70 km/h.

explain.short: The number is a distance in metres, not a speed limit.
explain.rule: 'Distanziamento minimo obbligatorio' (compulsory minimum distance): every vehicle must stay at least the distance shown, here 70 m, behind the vehicle in front.
explain.trap: '70 km/h' is wrong: the sign shows '70 m' (metres).

sceneParams.caption: Wrong: 70 m distance, not 70 km/h
lines: Stay at least 70 m behind the vehicle ahead
Applies to every vehicle, at any speed

q19591.en: The sign shown gives the maximum length of the tow rope.

explain.short: It shows the minimum distance between moving vehicles, not a tow rope.
explain.rule: 'Distanziamento minimo obbligatorio' (compulsory minimum distance): every vehicle must stay at least the distance shown, here 70 m, behind the vehicle in front.
explain.trap: 'cavo di traino' (tow rope) has nothing to do with this sign.

sceneParams.caption: Wrong: gap between vehicles, not tow rope
lines: Stay at least 70 m behind the vehicle ahead
Applies to every vehicle, at any speed
